test_case.test_name: Parameterized OS NIC TX/RX and physical-error statistics check
test_case.purpose: Verify the intended NIC interface exposes complete TX/RX statistics and accumulates no disallowed driver or physical error delta during the approved observation window.
required_package: ethtool and iproute2 versions compatible with the installed driver
Driver-specific counter dictionary mapping traffic, drop, CRC/FCS, symbol/alignment and physical errors
Observation window and signed allowed absolute/delta exceptions
Secure target access and pinned Script revision
test_case.test_command: Resolve interface identity; capture complete timestamped `ethtool -S <verified-interface>` and `ip -s link show dev <verified-interface>` at baseline and end of the approved passive window; normalize all counters by the supplied driver dictionary and compare absolute values/deltas without reset, truncation or link change.
test_case.expected_result: The exact interface remains present/up, complete statistics are readable, TX/RX counters are valid/nondecreasing, and every mapped error/drop/CRC/FCS/symbol/alignment/physical counter has zero delta by default or stays within an explicitly signed exception; no new driver/kernel link error appears.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires immutable interface identity, complete output and all configured delta rules satisfied. Wrong/missing interface, unreadable/truncated schema, counter rollback without documented driver reset, unapproved error delta, link flap or new driver error fails. Active traffic is outside this source unless separately authorized.
safety_gate: Prove netdev-to-NIC/port identity; never assume eth0.
Read complete statistics only; no reset, link configuration, driver restart or firmware action.
Preserve cumulative baseline and full output; do not clear counters.
Any active traffic requires a separate isolated profile and authorization; no automatic retry.
expected_evidence: Variant-bound NIC/interface identity and tool versions
Complete baseline and end ethtool/ip statistics transcripts
Driver counter dictionary and signed exception configuration
Absolute/delta matrix for traffic and all physical/error fields
Relevant driver/kernel logs and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: Read-only collection changes no state. On link/counter anomaly preserve evidence and stop; any reset or remediation belongs to a separate approved case.
